keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: LLM Evaluation Benchmarks and Judge Reliability
themes.summary: These papers evaluate LLMs and agents through benchmarks, judges, rubrics, and auditing protocols. They span real-time games, saturated benchmarks, multiple-choice option bias, social awareness, prompt injection, confidence calibration, and cultural or religious visual verification. A common thread is that judge reliability, role consistency, and uncertainty must be measured and corrected rather than assumed.

themes.name: Reward Modeling and RLVR Credit Assignment
themes.summary: These papers study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and reward modeling, asking whether reported gains reflect genuine improvement or artifacts such as answer format, noisy preference feedback, and data contamination. Several works instead design finer reward signals, localizing credit to the relevant words, tokens, operations, or page elements rather than broadcasting a single sequence-level score. Others analyze how rewards are aggregated, why majority-vote style labels can still track verifiable rewards, and whether automated gates can reliably certify self-improvement.

themes.name: Vision-language-action policy internals and deployment
themes.summary: These papers probe how vision-language-action policies represent tasks internally and how that understanding can be exploited, covering causal pathways, geometric structure, instruction following, physical state transitions, and memory. Others target deployment challenges such as aligning human egocentric video into training data, verifying or adaptively truncating action chunks at test time, anticipating contact anomalies with world models, and learning grasp or pose policies. They differ in whether they analyze existing VLA models mechanistically, propose new supervision targets or memory mechanisms, or add verification and data-generation scaffolding around a frozen policy.

themes.name: Agent Memory and Context Compaction
themes.summary: These papers study memory mechanisms and context compaction for long-horizon LLM agents, covering summarization, retrieval, memory composition, architecture evolution, and internalized history. They differ in whether memory is pruned, learned, repaired, versioned, or represented as weights, and in whether evaluation targets reliability, forgetting, or goal-adaptive compression.

themes.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration, Commitments, and Runtime Protocols
themes.summary: These papers study how LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate: learning collaboration topologies and runtime repair policies, retrieving agent cards at scale, and defining explicit protocols for commitments, responsibility, and status reporting. Some work targets decentralized coordination through commitments and responsibility, while others address bias in aggregation, hidden belief collapse, and separating bounded decisions from generation in workflows.

themes.name: On-Policy Distillation for Language and Vision-Language Models
themes.summary: Papers address on-policy distillation (OPD) where a student learns from teacher feedback on its own trajectories. They identify failure modes such as evidence-blind supervision, teacher unreliability on student-generated prefixes, and computational cost, then propose methods like information-gain calibration, condition-contrastive extrapolation, token-level teacher selection, stochastic truncation, and localized context distillation. Differences include applying OPD to deep search agents, vision-language models, flow-based VLA policies, long-horizon coding, and self-distillation from unverified peers.

themes.name: Adaptive Test-Time Reasoning and Compute Allocation
themes.summary: These papers develop methods for adaptive test-time reasoning, where models dynamically decide when to think longer and how to allocate inference compute. They differ in their control signals and mechanisms, including token-level selection, conformal early exit, decision-theoretic scheduling, and looped depth. The goal is to improve efficiency and accuracy by matching reasoning effort to problem difficulty.

themes.name: Low-Bit Quantization for Efficient LLM Inference
themes.summary: These papers advance low-bit quantization and inference efficiency for large language models, spanning power-of-two, ternary, and lookup-table weight representations as well as mixed-precision and runtime control for Mixture-of-Experts. They differ in whether they quantize weights, activations, or conditional memory, and in using calibration, pruning, quantization-aware training, or speculative decoding to meet hardware and accuracy constraints.

themes.name: KV Cache Compression and Long-Context Inference
themes.summary: These papers tackle memory and latency bottlenecks in long-context inference by compressing, reorganizing, or transferring key-value caches. Approaches include low-bit quantization with rotation calibration, learned pause-token compression, sparse eviction with post-selection positional geometry, remote cache tiers, streaming handoff for edge multi-agent systems, and speculative drafting without long-context drafters. They differ in whether they target cache representation, selection policy, positional coordinates, or cross-device reuse, with some proposing recurrent-state or negative-result alternatives.

themes.name: RAG Evidence Following and Verification
themes.summary: These papers study how retrieval-augmented generation systems use retrieved evidence, spanning medical report analysis, claim verification, multi-hop question answering, and multimodal document QA. They analyze when models follow or ignore evidence and introduce methods like query refinement, causal retrieval agents, and compact hallucination detectors. Differences lie in domain, modality, and whether the focus is on retrieval failure, evidence following, or verification.

themes.name: Diffusion Language Models: Sampling, Guidance, and Architectures
themes.summary: Papers in this theme advance diffusion language models across inference-time guidance, residual learning, representation design, and theoretical sampling. Some focus on efficient guidance schedules and tiny controllers for unmasking/remasking, while others investigate permutation parameterizations, multi-codebook discrete representations, and quantum-inspired dynamics. They differ in whether they target sampling corrections, trainable residual policies, or new architectural spaces.

themes.name: Federated Learning Privacy and Unlearning
themes.summary: The papers investigate privacy leakage, data poisoning, and unlearning in federated learning settings. They propose privacy-aware representation sharing, federated LLM unlearning, and edge unlearning benchmarks, while others evaluate attacks and argue behavioral forgetting is insufficient for privacy. Differences include focus on attack surfaces versus unlearning algorithms versus evaluation frameworks.

highlights.title: Stronger Judges Do Not See More: Deployment-Integrity Blindness in LLM Evaluation
highlights.authors: Jianchang Su, Dawei Xiang, Yifan Zhang et al.
highlights.theme: LLM Evaluation Benchmarks and Judge Reliability
highlights.why: Counterintuitively shows stronger LLM judges accept more tampered outputs, exposing deployment-integrity blindness that output-only evaluations cannot detect.
highlights.key_result: Stronger evaluators accept more tampered outputs: mean acceptance rises from 88.6% (rule-based) to 94.1% (GPT-5-nano), and a trigger-conditional tamper invisible on the evaluation suite produces 48--100% harmful outputs, rising with model capability. A PAC-style bound shows that tampers with zero output shift are undetectable from outputs at any sample size; a manifest-hash identity channel detects them with zero samples.

A PAC-style bound shows that tampers with zero output shift are undetectable from outputs at any sample size; a manifest-hash identity channel detects them with zero samples.

highlights.title: The Self-Improvement Problem
highlights.authors: Brian B. Moser, Stanislav Frolov, Tobias C. Nauen et al.
highlights.theme: Reward Modeling and RLVR Credit Assignment
highlights.why: Formally proves that no terminating automated gate can be both reliable and non-conservative for self-improvement, highlighting a fundamental structural limit.
highlights.key_result: In the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail, and randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit, as a gate that errs with probability at most 1/3 cannot exist. Under bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget, exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees.
evidence: We show that, in the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail. Randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit. We then identify a standard decidable regime used in practice (bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget) under which exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees.

First, randomness does not help. A gate that flips coins and errs with probability at most 1/3 can be converted into a deterministic sound and complete certifier, so it cannot exist either (Proposition ).

highlights.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
highlights.authors: Dongyue Lu, Guian Fang, Hur Lim et al.
highlights.why: First systematic benchmark for 3D consistency in interactive world models, with controlled exploration and revisit protocols.
highlights.key_result: Orbia is the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models, yielding 720 instances across six exploration-and-revisit protocols and evaluating 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models. SolarWM-H3 ranks first overall at 76.32.
evidence: Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters.
SolarWM-H3 ranks first overall at 76.32, with the strongest generated-content persistence and temporal stability among world models.
We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models.

highlights.title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
highlights.authors: Qian Yu, Zongyang Qiu, Juncheng Yan et al.
highlights.theme: Diffusion Language Models: Sampling, Guidance, and Architectures
highlights.why: Introduces the first fully discrete multi-codebook diffusion LLM for unified omni-visual understanding and generation, increasing representational capacity while preserving text-model compatibility.
highlights.key_result: Intern Lumina U2 is, to our knowledge, the first diffusion language model to represent multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. It achieves leading performance among unified models in visual understanding, image generation, and image editing, and its stability-aware sampling strategy accelerates image generation by 4.45.
evidence: We present Intern Lumina U2, to our knowledge the first diffusion language model to represent multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. Each visual position is represented by a group of codes from complementary codebooks, increasing its representational capacity while preserving compatibility with discrete text modeling.

Built on the unified 4D representation of AToken, Intern Lumina U2 supports image, video, and 3D inputs within a single backbone and achieves leading performance among unified models in visual understanding, image generation, and image editing. We further build a full-stack training, inference, and evaluation system on both Ascend and NVIDIA platforms to verify the cross-platform effectiveness of our model.
For image generation, a stability-aware inference strategy commits tokens at confidence plateaus and refreshes the cache on hidden-state drift, achieving a 4.45 end-to-end speedup.

Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind published a technical walkthrough in which biologists used its agentic development platform Google Antigravity, together with the ProtNLM model that predicts biological function from amino acid sequences, to uncover a novel antimicrobial peptide candidate with predicted activity against respiratory tract infection pathogens; the lead is now undergoing wet-lab validation. The post cites an estimated 10 million annual global deaths from antimicrobial resistance by 2050 and names a candidate bacteriocin (UniProt ID A0A0U0D591).

news.title: Anthropic update on independent evaluators
news.summary: Anthropic said it has onboarded six METR employees with company hardware, office space and access to internal tools and systems roughly on par with its own risk assessment teams, and that METR will publish its risk assessments without Anthropic being able to veto publication (Anthropic can require redaction only in narrow predefined categories). Anthropic also said it is working with SecureBio and Accenture as evaluators and is in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face.

news.title: Proof-based general-purpose computing with Magnetar
news.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Magnetar, a zero-knowledge proof system that proves programs written in Rust, Go or C, runs 10 to 39 times faster on average than the prior fastest comparable systems, and bases security only on standard hash functions. Microsoft said its Quantum Safe Program will move its products and services to post-quantum cryptography, a goal it recently accelerated to 2029.

news.title: Be There for the Beginning: Celebrate the Launch of NVIDIA RTX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA announced launch celebrations for RTX Spark on Friday, Oct. 16, at events in San Francisco, Berlin, Taipei, Beijing, Istanbul and Seoul, plus a #ShareYourSpark campaign offering an ASUS ProArt P14 RTX Spark laptop signed by Jensen Huang. The post quotes reviewer comments and cites independent testing from Artificial Analysis.

news.title: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models
news.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120-billion-parameter multimodal model it says delivers up to 5x faster throughput than the next best in its class and accuracy comparable to NVIDIA's largest reasoning model at roughly one-fifth the parameter count. Two edge models join it: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB, available now using native 2-bit quantization to fit in 24GB, and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, coming Oct. 23.

news.title: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA added DLSS 4.5 controls to GeForce NOW, including DLSS Super Resolution, Dynamic Multi Frame Generation (up to 4X for Ultimate members on GeForce RTX 5080-powered cloud rigs) and Ray Reconstruction, alongside 10 new games joining the service this week. Enshrouded left early access with its 1.0 release, skipping a 60GB local install, and raised the player level cap to 50 and equipment cap to 55 with nine new spells; Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 also began streaming at launch.

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Advanced Technology Access for Europe’s Scientific Community Through Open Learning Resources, Collaborations and Compute
news.summary: At the AI in Science Summit in Dublin, the European Commission launched the AI in Science Enablers Initiative connected to RAISE, with NVIDIA pledging accelerated tools and platforms, compute and cloud resources, skills training, collaborative projects and startup support. NVIDIA cited more than 250 open models, 250 open datasets and over 1,400 open source projects, a new NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute open source courseware hub, and compute collaborations with European national AI factories including in France, Spain and Sweden, where AI2F in France was the first AI factory to work with the Inception program for four months.

news.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
news.summary: NVIDIA described Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 12B parameters per token and delivers up to 5x higher throughput on a single GPU, with over 600 TPS on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index agentic tasks on the Baseten endpoint. It said organizations including Scale AI, Ramp and AI21 have post-trained the model, reporting gains such as 40x lower inference cost, 10x lower latency and 40% higher accuracy, and that developers can customize it with NVIDIA NeMo using supervised fine-tuning, low-rank adaptation and reinforcement learning.

news.title: Scale Agentic Coding Workflows with Meta’s Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72
news.summary: Meta's Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 42B parameters per token through top-8 routing across 256 experts with a 1M token context window, was trained on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Blackwell Ultra and runs agentic workloads at up to 50K tokens per second per GPU and up to 600 tokens per second per user. The model includes a 1.8B perception encoder for interleaved text, images, video frames and audio, and NVFP4 checkpoints optimized for Blackwell Ultra are available on Hugging Face.

news.title: Granite Switch 4.1: Chat, Decisions, and Speech from One Endpoint
news.summary: The Granite Switch 4.1 release comprises 8B and 30B models configured with a new Decision aLoRA for general-purpose decisions, a Guardian aLoRA that on average outperforms Jev 1.13, Microsoft-Decision-1, GPT-Luna-Decisions and Clef-Flash on safety-related decision tasks, and Granite-Speech-5.0-Turbo-CTC, described as the fastest ASR model on the OpenASR Leaderboard, composed into one model using about the same VRAM as the base model. A 3B Granite Switch model was reported to make 60-100 decisions per second in Doom versus Jev's reported 10 decisions per second, and Granite-Switch-4.1-30B completed a five-step RAG workflow faster than Jev-27B.

news.title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
news.summary: Meta's Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter MoE model with 42B active parameters, a 1M token context window and text, image, document, audio and audio-video input, is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart in BF16 (Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B) and NVFP4 quantized (Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4) variants. The post says the NVFP4 variant runs on ml.p5e.48xlarge and the BF16 variant on ml.p6-b300.48xlarge, with weights released under the Muse Model License including the Muse Spark Usage Policy.

news.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
news.summary: AWS described "Trust in Depth," an approach that combines automated reasoning with content filtering, testing and monitoring so agents can act autonomously where their rules can be precisely stated and proven, organized around scope, know, bound and observe questions across the agent lifecycle. AWS said it has run automated reasoning in production for more than a decade, including in IAM at more than 2.1 billion requests per second, and is now bringing it to agents.

themes.summary: 论文研究在线策略蒸馏（OPD），即学生从教师对其自身轨迹的反馈中学习。它们识别出证据盲监督、教师对学生生成前缀的不可靠性和计算成本等失败模式，然后提出了信息增益校准、条件对比外推、token 级教师选择、随机截断和局部上下文蒸馏等方法。区别包括将 OPD 应用于深度搜索智能体、视觉-语言模型、基于流的 VLA 策略、长程编码以及从未经验证的同伴进行自蒸馏。

themes.name: 自适应测试时推理与计算分配
themes.summary: 这些论文开发了自适应测试时推理方法，模型动态决定何时进行更长时间的思考以及如何分配推理计算。它们在控制信号和机制上有所不同，包括 token 级选择、共形早停、决策论调度和循环深度。目标是通过使推理努力与问题难度相匹配来提高效率和准确率。

themes.name: 面向高效 LLM 推理的低比特量化
themes.summary: 这些论文推进大语言模型的低比特量化和推理效率，涵盖二次幂、三值和查找表权重表示，以及混合专家模型的混合精度和运行时控制。它们的区别在于量化的是权重、激活还是条件记忆，以及使用校准、剪枝、量化感知训练或投机解码来满足硬件和精度约束。

themes.name: KV Cache 压缩与长上下文推理
themes.summary: 这些论文通过压缩、重组或迁移键值缓存来解决长上下文推理中的内存和延迟瓶颈。方法包括带旋转校准的低比特量化、学习到的暂停 token 压缩、带选择后位置几何的稀疏驱逐、远程缓存层、边缘多智能体系统的流式交接，以及无需长上下文草稿模型的投机解码。它们的不同之处在于目标是缓存表示、选择策略、位置坐标还是跨设备重用，有些工作提出了循环状态或负面结果替代方案。

themes.name: RAG 证据遵循与验证
themes.summary: 这些论文研究检索增强生成系统如何使用检索到的证据，涵盖医学报告分析、声明验证、多跳问答和多模态文档 QA。它们分析模型何时遵循或忽略证据，并引入了查询细化、因果检索智能体和紧凑幻觉检测器等方法。区别在于领域、模态以及关注点是检索失败、证据遵循还是验证。

themes.name: 扩散语言模型：采样、引导与架构
themes.summary: 该主题的论文在推理时引导、残差学习、表示设计和理论采样方面推进了扩散语言模型。一些工作侧重于高效的引导计划和用于 unmasking/remasking 的微型控制器，而另一些则研究置换参数化、多码本离散表示和量子启发的动力学。它们的不同之处在于目标是采样校正、可训练残差策略还是新的架构空间。

themes.name: 联邦学习隐私与遗忘
themes.summary: 这些论文研究联邦学习环境中的隐私泄露、数据投毒和遗忘。它们提出了隐私感知表示共享、联邦 LLM 遗忘和边缘遗忘基准，而另一些工作评估攻击并认为行为遗忘不足以保护隐私。区别包括关注攻击面、遗忘算法或评估框架。

highlights.title: Stronger Judges Do Not See More: Deployment-Integrity Blindness in LLM Evaluation
highlights.authors: Jianchang Su, Dawei Xiang, Yifan Zhang et al.
highlights.theme: LLM Evaluation Benchmarks and Judge Reliability
highlights.why: 反直觉地表明更强的 LLM 评估器会接受更多被篡改的输出，暴露出仅依赖输出的评估无法检测的部署完整性盲区。
highlights.key_result: 更强的评估器会接受更多被篡改的输出：平均接受率从 88.6%（基于规则）上升到 94.1%（GPT-5-nano），并且一种在评估套件上不可见的触发条件篡改会产生 48--100% 的有害输出，且随模型能力提升而增加。一个 PAC 式界限表明，零输出偏移的篡改在任何样本量下都无法从输出中检测；而基于清单哈希的身份通道可以用零样本检测到它们。
evidence: Stronger evaluators accept more tampered outputs: mean acceptance rises from 88.6% (rule-based) to 94.1% (GPT-5-nano), and a trigger-conditional tamper invisible on the evaluation suite produces 48--100% harmful outputs, rising with model capability. A PAC-style bound shows that tampers with zero output shift are undetectable from outputs at any sample size; a manifest-hash identity channel detects them with zero samples.

highlights.title: The Self-Improvement Problem
highlights.authors: Brian B. Moser, Stanislav Frolov, Tobias C. Nauen et al.
highlights.theme: Reward Modeling and RLVR Credit Assignment
highlights.why: 形式化地证明了对于自我改进，任何终止的自动门控都无法同时具备可靠性和非保守性，突显了一个根本性的结构限制。
highlights.key_result: 在完全一般的情况下，没有任何终止过程能够同时保证可靠性（绝不接受非改进）和非保守性（绝不遗漏可用的改进）：自指构造可以迫使任何此类门控或搜索器失败，且具有有界错误的随机化门控面临同样的限制，因为错误概率至多 1/3 的门控不可能存在。在有界评估和有限提议预算下，穷举模拟可以产生具有所需保证的终止搜索过程。
evidence: We show that, in the fully general setting, no terminating procedure can simultaneously guarantee reliability (never accepting a non-improvement) and non-conservatism (never missing an available improvement): self-referential constructions can force any such gate or searcher to fail. Randomized gates with bounded error face the same limit. We then identify a standard decidable regime used in practice (bounded evaluation and a finite proposal budget) under which exhaustive simulation yields a terminating search procedure with the desired guarantees.

First, randomness does not help. A gate that flips coins and errs with probability at most 1/3 can be converted into a deterministic sound and complete certifier, so it cannot exist either (Proposition ).

highlights.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
highlights.authors: Dongyue Lu, Guian Fang, Hur Lim et al.
highlights.why: 第一个针对交互式世界模型 3D 一致性的系统性基准，具有受控的探索和回访协议。
highlights.key_result: Orbia 是第一个专门用于系统、全面地评估交互式世界模型中 3D 一致性的基准，包含六个探索-回访协议下的 720 个实例，并评估了 27 个文本、动作和相机条件模型。SolarWM-H3 以 76.32 分位居总排名第一。
evidence: Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters.
SolarWM-H3 ranks first overall at 76.32, with the strongest generated-content persistence and temporal stability among world models.
We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models.

highlights.title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
highlights.authors: Qian Yu, Zongyang Qiu, Juncheng Yan et al.
highlights.theme: Diffusion Language Models: Sampling, Guidance, and Architectures
highlights.why: 提出了第一个用于统一全视觉理解与生成的全离散多码本扩散 LLM，在保持与文本模型兼容性的同时提高了表示容量。
highlights.key_result: 据我们所知，Intern Lumina U2 是第一个在完全离散空间中表示多码本视觉标记的扩散语言模型。它在统一模型中的视觉理解、图像生成和图像编辑方面取得了领先性能，其稳定性感知采样策略将图像生成速度提升了 4.45。
evidence: We present Intern Lumina U2, to our knowledge the first diffusion language model to represent multi-codebook visual tokens in a fully discrete space. Each visual position is represented by a group of codes from complementary codebooks, increasing its representational capacity while preserving compatibility with discrete text modeling.

Built on the unified 4D representation of AToken, Intern Lumina U2 supports image, video, and 3D inputs within a single backbone and achieves leading performance among unified models in visual understanding, image generation, and image editing. We further build a full-stack training, inference, and evaluation system on both Ascend and NVIDIA platforms to verify the cross-platform effectiveness of our model.
For image generation, a stability-aware inference strategy commits tokens at confidence plateaus and refreshes the cache on hidden-state drift, achieving a 4.45 end-to-end speedup.

highlights.title: JevAgentHarness: Benchmarking, Deploying and Training Decision Models That Share Control with LLMs
highlights.authors: Kunlun Zhu, Tao Feng, Xu Han et al.
highlights.theme: Multi-Agent Orchestration, Commitments, and Runtime Protocols
highlights.why: 构建了 AgentDecisionBench 和一个将工具选择委托给具有置信度阈值的 4B 决策模型的框架，在不显著损失成功率的情况下降低成本。
highlights.key_result: nmModel -4B 在智能体内比 Jev 做出更好的选择：在与训练数据不同的任务上，当 nmModel -4B 做出工具选择时，智能体解决了其中 e21/e12/l3/success% 的任务；当 Jev 做出选择时，解决了 e21/jev/l3/success% 的任务。并且在使用基于每个智能体状态训练的 4B 模型时，客服和家庭智能体的成本降低了 stage2/S2-4/cost_savings-- e11/cascade/saving%，速度最高提升至 round( jevres@e21b/e12_in/ref_wall / jevres@e21b/e12_in/wall ,1) 倍，同时成功率未下降 3 个百分点或更多。
evidence: nmModel -4B chooses better than Jev inside the agent: on tasks unlike its training data, the agent solved e21/e12/l3/success% of them when nmModel -4B made its tool choices and e21/jev/l3/success% when Jev made them.

nmHarness makes agents cheaper and faster: with 4B models trained on each agent's states, customer-service and household agents were stage2/S2-4/cost_savings-- e11/cascade/saving% cheaper and up to round( jevres@e21b/e12_in/ref_wall / jevres@e21b/e12_in/wall ,1) times faster, without losing 3 or more points of success.
On tasks unlike its training data, the agent solved e21/e12/l3/success% of them with nmModel -4B and e21/jev/l3/success% with Jev.

highlights.title: Intern-Decision: Efficient Multimodal Decision Making with Autoregressive Masked Language Modeling
highlights.authors: Tong Zhu, Zhe Xu, Zefeng He et al.
highlights.theme: Multi-Agent Orchestration, Commitments, and Runtime Protocols
highlights.why: 发布了 0.8B-4B 多模态决策模型，输出带有校准概率的结构化选择，在低延迟下于七个套件上达到 90.02% 的准确率。
highlights.key_result: Intern-Decision-4B 在七个评估套件上取得了 90.02% 的未加权平均准确率，而 Jev v1.13.0 为 88.74%。
evidence: The 4B model achieves a 90.02% unweighted average accuracy across seven evaluation suites, compared with 88.74% for Jev v1.13.0.
Across seven evaluation suites, including public Jevbench subsets , Intern-Decision-4B achieves a 90.02% unweighted mean accuracy, compared with 88.74% for Jev.

highlights.title: Memory as Weights: Internalizing Long-Term History for Streaming Videos
highlights.authors: Zhuoming Liu, Jinhong Lin, Lin Zhang et al.
highlights.why: 提出了一种内化的基于权重的流式记忆，并发布了一个大型指令数据集，在多个基准上优于基于上下文的记忆。
highlights.key_result: 在 OVO-Bench 的 backward 划分上，MaLoW 在不同视频骨干上优于先前记忆方法 3.9%--11.8%，同时仅带来适度的延迟开销。除了流式视频理解，MaLoW 还泛化到视觉-语言-动作模型，在 Simpler WidowX 上将动作成功率提高了 9.3%。
evidence: On the backward split of OVO-Bench, MaLoW outperforms prior memory approaches by 3.9%--11.8% across different video backbones while incurring only modest latency overhead. Beyond streaming video understanding, MaLoW also generalizes to vision-language-action models, improving the action success rate on Simpler WidowX by 9.3%.

highlights.title: CoTranslator: Reverse to Forward Chain-of-Thought Translator for Reasoning Distillation
highlights.authors: Zinan Tang, Zhuoshi Pan, Kairui Chen et al.
highlights.theme: On-Policy Distillation for Language and Vision-Language Models
highlights.why: 学习将逆向 CoT 转化为前向 CoT 分布，在 35.9% 的计算量下保留 95% 的拒绝采样准确率，并跨模型/任务迁移。
highlights.key_result: 在六个数学基准上评估的六个学生模型中，与语义抑制相比，平均准确率最多提高了 5.82 个百分点。对于两个 4B 学生模型，它在使用拒绝采样约 35.9% 的计算量的同时，保留了其 95.0% 的平均准确率。
evidence: Across six student models evaluated on six mathematics benchmarks, improves average accuracy over semantic suppression by up to 5.82 percentage points. For two 4B students, it retains 95.0% of rejection sampling's average accuracy while using 35.9% of its estimated compute.

news.title: Proof-based general-purpose computing with Magnetar
news.summary: Microsoft Research 推出了 Magnetar，这是一种零知识证明系统，可证明用 Rust、Go 或 C 编写的程序，平均运行速度比之前最快的同类系统快 10 到 39 倍，并且安全性仅基于标准哈希函数。Microsoft 表示其 Quantum Safe Program 将把其产品和服务迁移到后量子密码学，这一目标最近加速到 2029 年。

news.title: Be There for the Beginning: Celebrate the Launch of NVIDIA RTX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA 宣布将于 Oct. 16（周五）在旧金山、柏林、台北、北京、伊斯坦布尔和首尔举办 RTX Spark 发布庆祝活动，并推出 #ShareYourSpark 活动，提供一台由 Jensen Huang 签名的 ASUS ProArt P14 RTX Spark 笔记本电脑。帖子引用了评测者评论，并引用了 Artificial Analysis 的独立测试。

news.title: Open From Data Center to Desktop: NVIDIA Expands Nemotron Family With Highest Efficiency Super VL and Bolt Models
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，这是一个开放的 120-billion-parameter 多模态模型，据称其吞吐量比同类中表现次优的模型最高快 5x，并且准确度与 NVIDIA 最大的推理模型相当，而参数量约为其五分之一。同时推出两款边缘模型：Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB，现已可用，采用原生 2-bit 量化以适配 24GB 显存；以及 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，将于 Oct. 23 推出。

news.title: Dial Up the Cloud: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Controls Arrive on GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA 在 GeForce NOW 中加入了 DLSS 4.5 控制，包括 DLSS Super Resolution、Dynamic Multi Frame Generation（Ultimate 会员在 GeForce RTX 5080 驱动的云设备上最高 4X）和 Ray Reconstruction，本周还有 10 款新游戏加入该服务。Enshrouded 以 1.0 版本结束抢先体验，跳过了 60GB 本地安装，并将玩家等级上限提高到 50、装备上限提高到 55，新增九个法术；Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 也在发售时开始提供云游戏。

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Advanced Technology Access for Europe’s Scientific Community Through Open Learning Resources, Collaborations and Compute
news.summary: 在都柏林举行的 AI in Science Summit 上，欧盟委员会启动了与 RAISE 相关的 AI in Science Enablers Initiative，NVIDIA 承诺提供加速工具和平台、计算和云资源、技能培训、合作项目以及初创企业支持。NVIDIA 提到超过 250 个开放模型、250 个开放数据集和超过 1,400 个开源项目，一个新的 NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute 开源课件中心，以及与法国、西班牙和瑞典等欧洲国家 AI 工厂的计算合作，其中法国的 AI2F 是第一家与 Inception 项目合作四个月的 AI 工厂。

news.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Powers Specialized Agents with Multimodal Reasoning
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，这是一个开放的 120B 参数混合专家模型，每 token 激活 12B 参数，在单 GPU 上吞吐量最高提升 5 倍，在 Baseten 端点的 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 智能体任务上达到超过 600 TPS。NVIDIA 表示包括 Scale AI、Ramp 和 AI21 在内的组织已对该模型进行后训练，报告了推理成本降低 40 倍、延迟降低 10 倍和准确率提高 40% 等收益，并指出开发者可以使用 NVIDIA NeMo 通过监督微调、低秩适配和强化学习来定制该模型。

news.title: Scale Agentic Coding Workflows with Meta’s Muse Spark Open on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72
news.summary: Meta 的 Muse Spark Open 是一个 816B 参数的混合专家模型，通过跨 256 个专家的 top-8 路由每 token 激活 42B 参数，具有 1M token 上下文窗口，在 NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 Blackwell Ultra 上训练，并以每 GPU 每秒最高 50K token、每用户每秒最高 600 token 的速度运行智能体工作负载。该模型包含一个 1.8B 感知编码器，用于交错文本、图像、视频帧和音频，并且针对 Blackwell Ultra 优化的 NVFP4 检查点已在 Hugging Face 上提供。

news.title: Granite Switch 4.1: Chat, Decisions, and Speech from One Endpoint
news.summary: Granite Switch 4.1 版本包含 8B 和 30B 模型，配置了用于通用决策的新 Decision aLoRA、在安全相关决策任务上平均优于 Jev 1.13、Microsoft-Decision-1、GPT-Luna-Decisions 和 Clef-Flash 的 Guardian aLoRA，以及 Granite-Speech-5.0-Turbo-CTC，后者被描述为 OpenASR Leaderboard 上最快的 ASR 模型，它们被组合成一个模型，使用的 VRAM 与基础模型大致相同。据报道，一个 3B Granite Switch 模型在 Doom 中每秒做出 60-100 个决策，而 Jev 报告为每秒 10 个决策；Granite-Switch-4.1-30B 完成五步 RAG 工作流的速度快于 Jev-27B。

news.title: Meta’s Muse Spark Open now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
news.summary: Meta 的 Muse Spark Open 是一个 816B 参数的 MoE 模型，具有 42B 激活参数、1M token 上下文窗口，支持文本、图像、文档、音频和音视频输入，现已在 Amazon SageMaker JumpStart 中提供 BF16（Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B）和 NVFP4 量化（Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4）版本。该帖子称 NVFP4 版本在 ml.p5e.48xlarge 上运行，BF16 版本在 ml.p6-b300.48xlarge 上运行，权重以 Muse Model License 发布，包含 Muse Spark Usage Policy。

news.title: Trust in Depth: Giving agents more autonomy without losing control
news.summary: AWS 描述了“Trust in Depth”方法，该方法将自动推理与内容过滤、测试和监控相结合，使智能体能够在规则可以精确表述和证明的领域自主行动，并围绕智能体生命周期中的 scope、know、bound 和 observe 问题进行组织。AWS 表示，其已在生产环境中运行自动推理超过十年，包括在 IAM 中每秒处理超过 2.1 billion 请求，现在正将其引入智能体。
